supersedes_only: The per-row adjustflag equality rule in evidence/V2.8.5_HOLDOUT_ACQUISITION_INTEGRITY_AMENDMENT.json

post_adjust_query_rule.flag_3_acceptance_requires: For the same security, fetch adjustflag=3 and verify every returned flag=3 row has the same date and numerically equivalent open/high/low/close/preclose as the unadjusted row.
post_adjust_query_rule.snapshot_rows: Always persist the rows returned by the original adjustflag=1 query.

acquisition_architecture.reason: Sequential run processed about 200 of 1031 sample securities before 15 minutes elapsed; the original 45-minute single-job design has avoidable timeout risk.
acquisition_architecture.execution: Acquire the eight frozen deterministic buckets independently, with bounded parallelism, then merge only after all bucket integrity receipts PASS.
